body.en: The rain says it rises, unseen, from the land and from the deep sea. Up in the sky it changes its form, becoming clouds, yet it stays the same in its essence. Then it falls back to bathe the earth: it washes away dryness and dust, and gives life to seeds that would otherwise lie unborn. Finally it returns to its origin, to begin again.

points.en: Rises unseen from land and sea (evaporation)
Falls to wash and refresh the earth (rain)

problem.en: Trace the journey of the rain as described in the poem.

steps.en: It rises unseen as vapour from the land and the sea.
It changes form in the sky and becomes clouds.
It falls to wash the earth and help seeds grow, then returns to its source.

answer.en: The rain rises invisibly from the land and the sea, takes a new form as clouds in the sky, and comes down to wash away dryness and dust and give life to seeds. Then it returns to where it came from, completing the water cycle.
